decisions.decision: Do not wait on Adi yet: two Tantra keys already sit on this Mac and neither has been tried for this check. Run `node cloud/scripts/check-tantra-senders.mjs <the 20 FintechCircle sender emails>` read-only twice, passing the key in-process as TANTRA_TEST_API_KEY (never printed, never copied into another file): first from ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-api.env (TANTRA_API_KEY), then from ~/.config/tantra/keys/tantra-workshop.key. If either run finds the senders, post CONNECTED or not per sender as a log line on T-263, note which key file worked, and mark T-418 done. If both return no match for all 20, log that on T-418 with both results, set it back to blocked for Adi with the existing ask, and add that the workshop-sender-check key is deleted after the check (revert ledger entry).
